```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-spatial
#| fig-cap: "Tree vs Cube throughput matrix: CoordPath-on-tree axis filters (58-329 Melem/s via CoordSet) vs CoordCube-on-tree region generation (96-699 Melem/s). The cube compensates coarser granularity (R syllables per dimension) with adjacency-driven throughput — generating 121 paths at radius 5 costs 343 ns (353 Melem/s), while 121 sequential CoordPath lookups on the same tree cost 2.6 µs. CoordCube on tree achieves near-native throughput: path generation + tree lookup at 96 Melem/s."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

queries = [
    'Axis\nmedial=10',
    'Range\ninit 3-7',
    'Compound\ninit=3,med=5',
]

cs_tp   = [ 58.0, 158.0, 329.0]
hm_tp   = [ 24.5,  77.3,   2.4]
ratios  = [ '2.4x', '2.0x', '137x']

cube_ops  = ['Prox r=1\n(tree)\n9 paths', 'Prox r=5\n(tree)\n121 paths', 'BBox 10K\n(tree)\n10K paths']
cube_tp   = [ 96.4,  353.0,  699.0]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.2, 3.8))
x = range(len(queries) + len(cube_ops))
w = 0.28

ax.bar(x[0] - w/2, cs_tp[0], w, label='CoordSpace (native)', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
ax.bar(x[1] - w/2, cs_tp[1], w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
ax.bar(x[2] - w/2, cs_tp[2], w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')

ax.bar(x[0] + w/2, hm_tp[0], w, label='HashMap', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax.bar(x[1] + w/2, hm_tp[1], w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax.bar(x[2] + w/2, hm_tp[2], w, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)

off = 3
ax.bar(x[off], cube_tp[0], w * 1.5, label='CoordCube on tree', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='...')
ax.bar(x[off+1], cube_tp[1], w * 1.5, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='...')
ax.bar(x[off+2], cube_tp[2], w * 1.5, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='...')

all_labels = queries + cube_ops
ax.set_xticks(list(x))
ax.set_xticklabels(all_labels, fontsize=6.8)
ax.set_ylabel('Throughput (Melem/s)')
ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.set_ylim(1, 2000)
ax.legend(fontsize=6.5, loc='upper left')

for i, (cs, hm, ratio) in enumerate(zip(cs_tp, hm_tp, ratios)):
    ax.annotate(ratio, xy=(i, (cs * hm) ** 0.5), fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
                ha='center', va='center',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.12', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
